name: about-whyus

frames.best_why: The middle stat card is lifted on hover while the values, quote and all three numbers read clearly.

tagline: Why-us split with a client review and three big stat cards.
summary: A light about block split in two: the studio's values and a five-star client quote on the left, a positioning statement and three big stat cards on the right.
appearance: A pale grey page with faint diagonal stripes under a wide two-column layout. The left holds a heavy 'Why us', two rows of tiny icons with labels, five orange stars and an italic quote. The right has a large statement and three white rounded stat cards.
behaviour: Hovering a stat card lifts it slightly and deepens its shadow. Nothing else moves in the recording.
demo_content: 'Why us', a quote from Sarah Mitchell of Lunoa, and stats 105+ projects, 92% retention, 1M+ users reached.
search_phrases: why us section with client review
five star rating and quote beside stats
three big number cards on a light page
stat cards that lift on hover
about page with experience and dedication
use_when: An agency needs to answer why choose us with values, a review and hard numbers in one block.
avoid_when: Copy and numbers are hardcoded, and three stat cards feel tight in the right column.
customise: Values, quote, attribution and the three stat numbers are inline; card padding and the lift are classes.
weight_why: Static text and three cards with a CSS hover lift.

a11y.note: The star icons have no role or rating label, though the numeric 5.0 / 5 beside them carries the score.

issues: Every stat number and line of copy is fixed in the source file.
The third stat card sits tight against the right edge of the crop.
polish_why: Clean split layout with real numbers and a lift; the right edge is tight.
title: About Why Us
